name: trace-browser-extension
description: Trace browser extension source and iOS/macOS Safari wrapper

scripts.build:legacy:release: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=legacy node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:kernel: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:kernel:release: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:disabled: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=disabled node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:disabled:release: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=disabled node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:release && npm run zip:chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:release && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:session:packages && node --test test/collector.test.js test/library-overlay.test.js test/library-overlay-runtime.test.js test/library-overlay-site-hint.test.js test/background-runtime.test.js test/build-origin-permissions.test.mjs test/popup.test.js test/sync.test.js test/ao3-saved-filters.test.js test/prepare-store-screenshots.test.js
scripts.agent:check: npm run agent:lint && npm test && npm run build:release && npm run agent:lint
